svg.title: There is a basis bi, with b0 = 1, consisting of real polynomials of individual bidegrees (ri, fi). Indeed decompose into the finitely many bidegrees, and then into real and imaginary parts. The resulting real homogeneous elements span the complex space; choose an independent spanning subfamily containing 1. At successive horizons extend the previous independent family inside the same spanning set. This gives coherent frames: previous basis elements remain present as elements, although their nonzero index numbers need not remain fixed. The only elements with field number zero are constants. Hence fi > 0 for i ̸= 0. Coefficients c = (ci) mean the polynomial P i cibi; use P i |ci| as a coefficient norm. There are two different scaling operations:
